tenant_id.description: The tenant whose quota add-on balance changed.

limit_key.description: The limit key this add-on extends (e.g. llm_token_quota_monthly).

total_tokens.description: Total token capacity of the add-on pack.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the change (e.g. promotional_grant, operator_correction, migration_credit).

action.description: What happened to the add-on pack.

granted_at.description: Wall-clock time the operator originally granted this add-on pack.

expires_at.description: When this add-on pack expires; omitted when no expiry is set.
